name: web_search
description: Search the web using DuckDuckGo. Returns top 10 results with titles and URLs.

name: fetch_url
description: Fetch and read the content of any URL as clean Markdown (via Jina Reader). Use for reading articles, docs, or any web page.

name: bash
description: Run a bash command in the project directory. Use this to read files (cat), list directories (ls), search code (grep), check git status, run scripts, or any shell operation.

name: write_file
description: Create or overwrite a file with the given content. Use for creating new scripts, configs, or any file from scratch. Set append=true to add to an existing file.

path.description: Relative path to the file to create or overwrite.

content.description: The full content to write to the file.

append.description: If true, append to the file instead of overwriting. Default: false.

name: search_files
description: Search for a text pattern across project files using grep. Returns matching lines with file paths and line numbers.

pattern.description: The text or regex pattern to search for.

path.description: Directory or file to search in. Defaults to project root.

file_glob.description: Filename glob to filter files, e.g. '*.sh' or '*.py'. Default: all files.

name: todo
description: Manage a per-session task list. Use to plan and track multi-step work. Actions: add, list, done, delete, clear.

session.description: Session identifier for the todo list. Defaults to 'default'.

name: clarify
description: Send a clarifying question to the user before taking an ambiguous or irreversible action. Stops the current turn and waits for their reply.

question.description: The question to ask the user.

name: process
description: Run shell commands in the background and manage them. Actions: run (start), list (show all), output (get logs), kill (stop).

command.description: The bash command to run in background (required for 'run').

name.description: A label for the process. Used to reference it in output/kill. Auto-generated if not provided.

name: session_search
description: Search past conversation history for a keyword or phrase across all sessions or a specific one.

query.description: The keyword or phrase to search for.

session.description: Specific session ID to search (e.g. 'tg_670967877'). Searches all sessions if omitted.

limit.description: Max number of matching snippets to return per session. Default: 20.

name: image_generate
description: Generate an image from a text prompt using Pollinations AI (free, no key required). Returns a URL to the generated image.

prompt.description: Description of the image to generate.

name: edit_code
description: Edit a file by replacing a specific block of text with new text. Validates bash syntax after edit and auto-reverts on error.

path.description: Path to the file to edit.

old_text.description: The exact text to find and replace (must appear exactly once).

new_text.description: The new text to replace old_text with.

name: repo_map
description: Get a tree view of the entire project structure.

depth.description: Max depth for the tree. Defaults to 3.

name: memory_remember
description: Save an important fact or note to long-term memory for future recall.

metadata_json.description: Optional JSON metadata string, e.g. {"topic": "user preferences"}.

name: memory_recall
description: Search long-term memory for relevant information using a query.

query.description: Search query to find relevant memories.

limit.description: Max number of results to return. Defaults to 3.

name: sys_info
description: Get current system stats: CPU load, memory usage, disk space, uptime.

name: read_error_log
description: Read recent errors from the agent error log to diagnose issues.

name: custom_tool_manager
description: Create, list, or delete custom tools. Use 'create' to build new automation scripts.

name.description: Tool name (used as filename, no spaces).

code.description: The bash script code for the tool.

parameters_json.description: JSON schema of the tool's parameters.

name: insights
description: Show token usage statistics and tool usage frequency.
